query:
with reporting_dates as (
select date::date as date
from generate_series(
:fromDate,
:toDate,
'1 day'::interval
) date
)
select
to_char(rd.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
ir.facility as "Facility",
ir.department as "Department",
ir.imaging_type as "Imaging type",
count(distinct ir.request_id) filter (where ((ir.requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date = rd.date) as "Total new requests",
count(distinct ir.request_id) filter (
where ((ir.requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date <= rd.date
and (((ir.completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date > rd.date or ir.completed_datetime is null)
) as "Total requests with a status of pending",
count(distinct ir.request_id) filter (
where ((ir.completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date = rd.date
) as "Total requests completed"
from reporting_dates rd
left join "reporting"."ds__imaging_requests" ir
on ir.status_id not in ('cancelled', 'deleted', 'entered_in_error')
and ((ir.requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date <= rd.date
and (((ir.completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))::date >= rd.date or ir.completed_datetime is null)
where ir.status_id not in ('cancelled', 'deleted', 'entered_in_error')
and (ir.department_id is not null or ir.imaging_type is not null)
and (
:department is null or ir.department_id = 
:department
)
and (
case
when 
:imagingType is null then true
else ir.imaging_type_id = 
:imagingType
end
)
group by rd.date, ir.facility, ir.facility_id, ir.department, ir.department_id, ir.imaging_type
order by rd.date, ir.facility, ir.facility_id, ir.department, ir.department_id, ir.imaging_type
name: Imaging requests summary
notes:
This report generates a statistical summary of imaging requests by date, department and imaging type. Each indicator is reported by day. Dates are listed chronologically by department and imaging type. Imaging requests with a status of cancelled, deleted or entered in error are excluded from this report. 

Details on how each indicator is calculated are provided below:
- Total new requests = The number of imaging requests generated on the specified day. 
- Total requests with a status of pending = The number of imaging requests with a status of pending. This number may include requests generated on a different date. 
- Total requests completed = The number of imaging requests with status updated to completed on the specified day.
